detail.en-US: Separate report and provider clocks, with matched recent samples.
detail.zh-CN: 分别核对研报和供应商时间，并保留近期同样本对照。

detail.en-US: Original provider vintages remain unknown, especially before the 2022 update batch.
detail.zh-CN: 原始历史版本仍缺少记录，2022年批量更新之前尤其明显。

detail.en-US: Historical price observations are used; analyst coverage and industry vintages remain selected or reconstructed.
detail.zh-CN: 使用历史行情中的股票，券商覆盖有选择性，行业归属按记录重建。

detail.en-US: Selected missing prices suppress the monthly spread; settlement values remain unresolved.
detail.zh-CN: 选中股票缺价格时整月不报收益差，退市结算价值仍待补齐。

detail.en-US: Next-session close to next formation next-session close; actual fills are unqualified.
detail.zh-CN: 从汇总日的下一交易日收盘算到下次入场日收盘，实际成交仍待核对。

detail.en-US: Three per-side fee assumptions; borrowing, impact and terminal liquidation are excluded.
detail.zh-CN: 比较三档单边费用，尚未计入借券、冲击和最终清仓费用。

data_version.en-US: Completed 191-month acquisition and hashed run-02 inputs/results.
data_version.zh-CN: 已完成191个月回补，并记录第二次运行的输入和结果哈希。

missing.en-US: Historical vintages, delisting settlement and actual fills are unverified. Intervals are descriptive and multiple comparisons are unadjusted.
missing.zh-CN: 历史版本、退市结算和实际成交仍待核实。不确定区间用于描述样本波动，多项比较尚未作统一校正。

resume_when.en-US: Does forecast information add to currently reported valuation on newly observed snapshots?
resume_when.zh-CN: 在新观察日版本中，预测信息能否比当前已公布盈利多提供一些帮助？

action.en-US: Accumulate immutable observation-date snapshots and score later outcomes.
action.zh-CN: 积累不可变的观察日快照，再检验随后结果。

acceptance.en-US: Retain original retrieval versions and predeclared future outcomes.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留原始抓取版本，事先记录未来检验的结果口径。

action.en-US: Resolve missing terminal prices and qualify trading constraints.
action.zh-CN: 补齐期末价格和终止事件，核对交易限制。

acceptance.en-US: Every selected endpoint has a justified value and fill assumptions are separately qualified.
acceptance.zh-CN: 每个选中股票的期末价值有据可查，成交假设另行核对。
